{{Top|leg}}
'''Fathalians''' were [[Human/Legends|human]] immigrants who inhabited the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[JanFathal]]. Many of them resided in JanFathal's capital, [[Athar]], and were known as [[Athari]]. They had dark skin, and wore their hair in neatly-coiled plaits.<ref name="No Prisoners">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref>

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Fathalians wished for [[Democracy/Legends|democratic]] change, but they were told by [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] that their request would have to wait until the conclusion of the war.<ref name="No Prisoners" />
